service.name: AudioSearchService
service.description: Kanaha Audio Search Service — audio keyword search, transcription, recording, and tone playback via HTTP/2 JSON-RPC and MCP (Model Context Protocol). Uses whisper.cpp for on-device speech-to-text, YAMNet for audio event detection, AAudio NDK for microphone recording and tone generation, and GPS for location metadata. Enables automated third-camera priority cuts and multi-device audio synchronization.

operation.name: searchKeywords
operation.parameter: Search for keyword phrases in an audio file and return timestamps. Primary use case: finding 'next slide please' to automate third-camera priority cuts. Returns matches with start_ms, end_ms, and confidence.

{"type":"object","properties":{"audio_file":{"type":"string","description":"Path to audio file (WAV)"},"keywords":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Keyword phrases to search for"}},"required":["audio_file","keywords"]}

operation.name: transcribe
operation.parameter: Transcribe an audio file with word-level timestamps using whisper.cpp.

operation.name: getStatus
operation.parameter: Get audio service status: whisper model state, device info, memory usage.

operation.name: listModels
operation.parameter: List available whisper ggml models on the device with sizes and loaded state.

operation.name: loadModel
operation.parameter: Load or switch the active whisper model. Only one at a time.

operation.name: detectAudioEvents
operation.parameter: Detect non-speech audio events using YAMNet (Google AudioSet classifier). Identifies instruments (Saxophone, Piano, Guitar), events (Applause, Silence), and 521 other AudioSet classes with timestamps and confidence scores.

{"type":"object","properties":{"audio_file":{"type":"string","description":"Path to audio file (WAV)"},"events":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"AudioSet class names to detect"},"threshold":{"type":"number","description":"Confidence threshold 0.0-1.0 (default 0.5)"},"mode":{"type":"string","description":"all, first_onset, or last_offset"},"time_range_start":{"type":"number","description":"Start of search window (seconds)"},"time_range_end":{"type":"number","description":"End of search window (seconds)"}},"required":["audio_file","events"]}

operation.name: listAudioFiles
operation.parameter: List audio files available for processing.
{"type":"object","properties":{"directory":{"type":"string","description":"Directory to scan. Default: app audio directory"}},"required":[]}

operation.name: startRecording
operation.parameter: Start recording audio from the device microphone to WAV format. Supports start_at scheduling for multi-device sync.

{"type":"object","properties":{"clip_name":{"type":"string","description":"Name for the recording (WAV filename prefix)"},"sample_rate":{"type":"integer","description":"16000 (default) or 44100"},"start_at":{"type":"integer","description":"Unix epoch ms to start. 0 = immediate"}},"required":["clip_name"]}

operation.name: stopRecording
operation.parameter: Stop the active recording. Finalizes WAV header and returns duration and file size.

operation.name: playTone
operation.parameter: Play a sine wave tone through the device speaker for multi-device synchronization. Supports start_at scheduling with kernel-level precision.

{"type":"object","properties":{"frequency":{"type":"integer","description":"Tone frequency in Hz"},"duration_ms":{"type":"integer","description":"Duration in milliseconds"},"start_at":{"type":"integer","description":"Unix epoch ms to start. 0 = immediate"}},"required":["frequency","duration_ms"]}

operation.name: listRecordings
operation.parameter: List WAV recordings with file sizes and estimated durations.
